<script>
// LOADER
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.getElementById('loader').classList.add('hidden');
  }, 2000);
});

// NAV SCROLL
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 50);
});

// SCROLL REVEAL
const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      e.target.classList.add('visible');
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

// CALENDAR
const bookings = {};
let selectedDate = null;
let selectedTime = null;
let currentMonth, currentYear;

const now = new Date();
currentMonth = now.getMonth();
currentYear = now.getFullYear();

const MONTHS = ['Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre'];
const DAYS = ['Dom','Lun','Mar','Mié','Jue','Vie','Sáb'];
const TIMES = ['10:00','10:30','11:00','11:30','12:00','12:30','13:00','14:00','14:30','15:00','15:30','16:00','16:30','17:00','17:30','18:00','18:30'];
const MAX_SLOTS = 6;

// Simulate some booked slots
function getBookingsForDate(dateStr) {
  return bookings[dateStr] || [];
}

function renderCalendar() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('calendarGrid');
  const firstDay = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 1).getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
  const today = new Date();
  
  let html = `<div class="calendar-header">
    <button class="cal-nav" onclick="prevMonth()">‹</button>
    <span class="cal-month">${MONTHS[currentMonth]} ${currentYear}</span>
    <button class="cal-nav" onclick="nextMonth()">›</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cal-days-header">
    ${DAYS.map(d => `<div class="cal-day-label">${d}</div>`).join('')}
  </div>
  <div class="cal-days">
    ${Array(firstDay).fill('<div class="cal-day empty"></div>').join('')}`;

  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    const dateStr = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const dayDate = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, d);
    const isPast = dayDate < new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());
    const isToday = d === today.getDate() && currentMonth === today.getMonth() && currentYear === today.getFullYear();
    const booked = getBookingsForDate(dateStr).length;
    const isFull = booked >= MAX_SLOTS;
    const isSelected = dateStr === selectedDate;
    
    let cls = 'cal-day';
    if (isPast) cls += ' disabled';
    else if (isFull) cls += ' full';
    else if (isSelected) cls += ' selected';
    if (isToday) cls += ' today';
    
    html += `<div class="${cls}" onclick="${isPast || isFull ? '' : `selectDate('${dateStr}')`}" title="${isFull ? 'Sin disponibilidad' : ''}">${d}</div>`;
  }
  
  html += '</div>';
  grid.innerHTML = html;
}

function prevMonth() {
  currentMonth--;
  if (currentMonth < 0) { currentMonth = 11; currentYear--; }
  renderCalendar();
}

function nextMonth() {
  currentMonth++;
  if (currentMonth > 11) { currentMonth = 0; currentYear++; }
  renderCalendar();
}

function selectDate(dateStr) {
  selectedDate = dateStr;
  selectedTime = null;
  renderCalendar();
  renderTimeSlots(dateStr);
  document.getElementById('timeSlotsSection').style.display = 'block';
}

function renderTimeSlots(dateStr) {
  const booked = getBookingsForDate(dateStr);
  const remaining = MAX_SLOTS - booked.length;
  const avail = document.getElementById('availMsg');
  const slotsDiv = document.getElementById('timeSlots');
  
  if (remaining <= 0) {
    slotsDiv.style.display = 'none';
    avail.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  avail.style.display = 'none';
  slotsDiv.style.display = 'grid';
  
  const takenTimes = booked;
  slotsDiv.innerHTML = TIMES.map(t => {
    const isTaken = takenTimes.includes(t);
    const isSelected = t === selectedTime;
    return `<button class="time-slot ${isTaken ? 'taken' : ''} ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}" onclick="${isTaken ? '' : `selectTime('${t}')`}" ${isTaken ? 'disabled' : ''}>${t}</button>`;
  }).join('');
}

function selectTime(t) {
  selectedTime = t;
  if (selectedDate) renderTimeSlots(selectedDate);
}

function submitBooking() {
  const name = document.getElementById('clientName').value;
  const phone = document.getElementById('clientPhone').value;
  const service = document.getElementById('serviceSelect').value;
  
  if (!name || !phone || !service || !selectedDate || !selectedTime) {
    showNotification('Por favor completa todos los campos 💖');
    return;
  }
  
  if (!bookings[selectedDate]) bookings[selectedDate] = [];
  bookings[selectedDate].push(selectedTime);
  
  showNotification(`¡Cita confirmada! ${selectedDate} a las ${selectedTime} 💖`);
  renderCalendar();
  renderTimeSlots(selectedDate);
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    showNotification(`Hola hermosa 💖 te recordamos tu cita mañana en ARGE STYLE. ¡Te esperamos!`);
  }, 3000);
}

function openBooking(service) {
  document.getElementById('serviceSelect').value = service;
  document.getElementById('citas').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
}

renderCalendar();

// NOTIFICATION
function showNotification(msg) {
  const n = document.getElementById('notification');
  n.querySelector('br').nextSibling.textContent = msg;
  n.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove('show'), 4000);
}

// FAQ
function toggleFaq(btn) {
  const item = btn.parentElement;
  const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
  if (!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}

  'Ubicación': '📍 Estamos en Santa Catarina, Nuevo León. Escríbenos por WhatsApp y te mandamos la ubicación exacta en Google Maps 💖',
};

function toggleChat() {
  document.getElementById('chatWindow').classList.toggle('open');
}

function chatReply(question) {
  const msgs = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
  const userMsg = document.createElement('div');
  userMsg.className = 'chat-msg user';
  userMsg.textContent = question;
  msgs.appendChild(userMsg);
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    const botMsg = document.createElement('div');
    botMsg.className = 'chat-msg bot';
    botMsg.textContent = chatResponses[question] || 'Escríbenos por WhatsApp para más información 💖';
    msgs.appendChild(botMsg);
    msgs.scrollTop = msgs.scrollHeight;
    
    if (question === 'Quiero cotizar' || question === 'Agendar cita') {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const waMsg = document.createElement('div');
        waMsg.className = 'chat-msg bot';
        waMsg.innerHTML = '<a href="https://wa.me/521234567890" target="_blank" style="color:var(--peach)">💬 Abrir WhatsApp →</a>';
        msgs.appendChild(waMsg);
        msgs.scrollTop = msgs.scrollHeight;
      }, 600);
    }
  }, 500);
  
  msgs.scrollTop = msgs.scrollHeight;
}

// Contact form
function submitContact(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  showNotification('¡Mensaje enviado! Te contactaremos pronto 💖');
}

}, 3000);
